thread:
maria: seeing p99 spike on /v1/chat in us-west-2 — started ~10:12 UTC, affects multiple paying customers, p99 ≈ 5.2s, p95 ≈ 720ms. raising here before paging.
alex: link to the dashboards? query? I can join. 
maria: https://dash.redwood.com/r/latency?svc=chat&region=us-west-2 — top tail on replica-3, error rate low so it's latency, not GC. logs show repeated KV-cache misses and tokenization timeouts.
kevin: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback model for /v1/chat 2) open circuit-breaker for heavy clients 3) tighten rate-limit on noisy API keys. want me to run?
rachel: on it — opening CB for route /v1/chat for requests exceeding 3s (p99 threshold).
rachel: command:
```
srectl circuit-breaker create --route "/v1/chat" --threshold-ms 3000 --window 60s --action "throttle:50%"
```
ops-bot: circuit-breaker created (id cb-20250309-17), status OPEN :warning:
sam: repro curl I'm using to simulate heavy seq lengths:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-13b", "input":"<long prompt>" , "max_tokens":1024}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
sam: adding header X-REDWOOD-TRACE:1 to surface kv-cache hits.
kevin: fallback plan (do now): set route fallback model to rwd-7b-quant and lower batching window. command:
```
redwoodctl route update --path /v1/chat --fallback-model rwd-7b-quant --batch-window-ms 8
```
luca: spinning up 2 extra replicas in us-west-2 dedicated pool (temporary burst). doing a quick scale command.
deploy-bot: rollout rwd-13b-v2 -> us-west-2 completed at 09:59 (id: rl-20250309-99)
maria: we should also limit per-key qps for top offenders. sample rl command:
```
ratelimitctl set --key <api-key> --service /v1/chat --rate 20/s --burst 40
```
kevin: will notify Support to set expectations for affected customers, include mitigation steps and ETA to revert rollout if needed.
rachel: CB is active and we see p99 drop to ~2.1s within 90s. applying fallback now.
rachel: update: fallback model routing applied, batch-window reduced. p99 trending down to 550ms.
maria: summary action items:
- CB id cb-20250309-17 stays open until we validate p99 stable <600ms for 30min
- fallback model rwd-7b-quant active; plan A: keep for 1h then re-evaluate
- scale reverted after spike subsides
- support alerted, billing unaffected
any objections? :thumbsup:
alex: +1, log a follow-up postmortem and check kernel/quantization perf diffs.
kevin: opening an incident doc now and assigning owners for root-cause (possible KV-cache regression after rollout).
maria: thanks all — tagging ops rotation for handoff in 20m. I'll leave CB in OPEN and post final notes when we close.
ops-bot: scheduled handoff to oncall-night at 10:00 UTC. :spiral_calendar:
